ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 3:2 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity cream/off-white pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large high-intensity interior regions separated by a low-intensity central channel. Left lobe contains three prominent near-vertical black streaks. Right lobe contains one isolated dark circular focal spot within the high-intensity region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide-angle V-shaped indentation, approximately 135 degrees, with a shallow bounding-box depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits a more jagged peak-to-valley profile compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory with tips oriented vertically; overall shape exhibits symmetrical outward expansion from the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white clusters located on the outer edges of the left and right tips, consistent with barnacle attachment scars.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small dark circular lesion or pigmentation spot located in the central-right light-intensity region; ragged edge topography consistent with environmental wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct yellowish-tan chromatic shift within the high-intensity interior regions compared to neutral white.
